title: EPILOGUE - Epilogue: Beyond the Contract
hook: The screeching is gone. The clearing is quiet, the open sky calm. Somewhere west, a city you may never see is waking up safe because of what you did tonight. The Custodian is already shuffling you back toward warmth...

blocks.label: Current Beat
blocks.body: The screeching is gone. The clearing is quiet, the open sky calm. Somewhere west, a city you may never see is waking up safe because of what you did tonight. The Custodian is already shuffling you back toward warmth and food and a fire that does not want...

blocks.label: Public Objective
blocks.body: Rest, reckon with what you did, and decide what you carry forward.

affordances: Ask one practical question before acting.
